description: Click, type, select, hover, scroll, press a key, drag or wait, to get the app into the state you want to capture. Type secrets as "$env:NAME": the value is read from this machine's environment and never recorded or uploaded.

target.description: How to find an element: prefer role+name, then text, then selector.

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

value.description: Text to type, option to select, key to press, pixels to scroll, or the drop target's text

name: capture_act
title: Interact with the app
